family.shared_definition: an upward movement or scaling of a mountain, cliff, or hill
family.semantic_notes: 'Ascent' is more formal and geographical, while 'climb' is everyday and emphasizes the physical effort or specific route.

source_context_dev: Loose scree and sudden avalanches threatened every foothold along the vertical granite wall. After narrowly dodging falling boulders near the icy couloir, everyone exhaled in relief.
The sheer overhang was coated in deceptive black ice with hundred-foot drops right below. One wrong placement of an anchor would have meant certain disaster.
Severe weather and brittle rock faces tested the expedition's survival instincts to their absolute limits. Navigating the exposed precipice required nerves of steel amid howling winds.
Crumbling handholds and treacherous crevasses made the route notorious among alpine veterans. Escaping the deadly north face intact seemed almost miraculous.
target_context_dev: The newly mapped alpine track demanded exceptional technical skill and steady physical endurance. While safe from major rockfall, it required continuous problem-solving at every pitch.
Navigating the intricate maze of fissures called for precision and sophisticated route-finding. The team tested their advanced athletic techniques against the steep incline.
Although well-protected by modern bolts, the sheer angle demanded peak concentration and stamina. Each difficult pitch pushed the athletes to refine their body positioning.
The route offered a formidable test of technique without posing unnecessary life-threatening risks. It rewarded methodical tactical movement across complex vertical terrain.
source_context_test: Raging blizzards and unstable cornices made every single meter on the jagged ridge a gamble with fate. A single slip over the void would have been fatal.
The crumbling basalt columns offered unreliable protection over a sickening vertical drop. Danger mounted with every gust of sub-zero wind howling across the gully.
Jagged icicles sheared off above the narrow ledge, threatening to sweep the expedition off the mountainside. Traversing such lethal terrain demanded hypervigilance.
Unanchored rock slabs threatened to collapse under the slightest pressure near the summit headwall. Surviving the deadly exposure took absolute focus.
target_context_test: The high-grade technical route pushed modern athletic capabilities with awkward body movements. It stood out as an intellectual puzzle of balance and grip strength.
Mastering the intricate friction slabs required immense patience and flawless footwork. The difficulty stemmed from subtle balance rather than raw environmental hazards.
The elevation gain was grueling, demanding seasoned fitness and sharp problem-solving skills throughout the day. It proved to be a demanding athletic milestone.
Navigating the steep granite overhang required advanced rope management and precise maneuvers. It was widely regarded as a benchmark test of mountaineering prowess.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations (perilous climb, perilous ascent, challenging climb, challenging ascent) are grammatically correct and semantically natural in all provided contexts.
